module: Core of the "gameplaySelector" backend: it chooses which tiles to display according to the navigation path (all activities, detail of a system or a level, level spawn points, "discover" page). At load time it scans the tileGenerators/ folder and declares each generator (ui_gameplaySelector_tileGenerators_<name>) as a dependency. It relies on the tileClustering and tileSorting modules and provides the selector's grouping and sorting functions.
notes: Tiles come from backend.getUiData(routeName).items, filled by the generators' onGameplaySelectorGetTiles hooks; getTiles does not recompute them.
For the freeroamSelector backend, the validItems list is built by filtering on validBackends but is never used afterwards: the handlers receive the full items list (probable inconsistency).
Recognized path types (path.keys[1]): allGameplay (default and unknown path), detailGameplay, spawnPointsForLevel, discoverPage.

dependencies.desc: core_locales plus one extension per file found in lua/ge/extensions/ui/gameplaySelector/tileGenerators/ (list built when the file loads).

getTiles.desc: Returns the tiles or groups to display for a path. Stores the backend, updates showFavouriteIconPercent of each tile (1 if favorite) and the "road" cornerIcon of the selected freeroam spawn points, then routes to the handler matching path.keys[1].

path.desc: Navigation path: table with keys (list of strings).

_backend.desc: Calling backend (gameplaySelector or freeroamSelector), with getUiData, isFavourite, backendName.

returns.desc: Tiles or groups depending on the path handler.

getUiData.desc: Returns the backend's UI data: backendName ("gameplaySelector"), the grouping functions (Type, Category, Difficulty, Source, System), the sorting functions (Name, Difficulty, Duration, Popularity) and the tileSorting module.
